cards.meaning: to fall back, retreat, ease off (of a price/level from a high)
cards.example: 油价从100美元回落到89美元左右。
cards.examplePinyin: yóu jià cóng yì bǎi měi yuán huí luò dào bā shí jiǔ měi yuán zuǒ yòu
cards.exampleMeaning: Oil prices fell back from 100 dollars to around 89.
cards.note: 书面语 / financial-desk register. Crucial near-synonym contrast: 回落 (huíluò) means falling back FROM A HIGH toward a lower level — a pullback — while 下跌 (xiàdiē) is just 'to go down' with no sense of returning. Natural collocations: 油价回落, 股价回落, 通胀回落 (oil / share prices / inflation ease back). Use it for a correction off a peak, not a general decline.
cards.tiesTo: Brent crude falling back ~8% from ~$100 toward $89 on the Iran strike pause

cards.meaning: meanwhile; at the same time (formal connective linking two simultaneous developments)
cards.example: 油价回落；与此同时，人工智能股票继续下跌。
cards.examplePinyin: yóu jià huí luò; yǔ cǐ tóng shí, rén gōng zhì néng gǔ piào jì xù xià diē
cards.exampleMeaning: Oil prices fell back; meanwhile, AI stocks kept falling.
cards.note: HSK-4 connective, 书面语/formal. Same idea as the colloquial 同时 (tóngshí) but 与此同时 is the written, newsroom choice and usually opens the clause introducing the second, simultaneous event. Pattern: [event A]，与此同时，[event B]. Pairs perfectly with the day's throughline — one pressure receding 与此同时 another persisting.
cards.tiesTo: the throughline — war premium receding while the AI-capex de-rating continues at the same time

cards.meaning: easing, relief, breathing room; slack or leeway after a period of tightness
cards.example: Ang pagbaba ng presyo ng langis ay nagbigay ng kaluwagan sa piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The fall in oil prices gave the peso some relief.
cards.note: Native-speaker nuance and a useful contrast with the already-learned ginhawa: ginhawa is a felt sense of comfort/ease, while kaluwagan is the space or slack you get after a tightness lets up — financial or otherwise. Root is luwag (looseness). Collocations: magbigay ng kaluwagan (to give relief), may kaluwagan (to have breathing room). Common in economics writing for policy or budget relief.
cards.tiesTo: cheaper oil easing the pressure on the peso and the family budget (98%-oil-import economy)

cards.meaning: austerity; thrift or economizing as a policy or principle
cards.example: Ang tema ng SONA ni Marcos ay katipiran.
cards.exampleMeaning: The theme of Marcos's State of the Nation address is austerity.
cards.note: Register contrast: everyday tipid (to be thrifty, save money) is personal and casual; katipiran elevates it to a policy or principle — the frugality of a government, an institution, or a whole nation. Root is tipid. Fits the formal SONA framing of belt-tightening; you would not use katipiran for skipping a coffee, but you would for a national austerity program.
cards.tiesTo: Marcos's fifth SONA framed around austerity against ₱18.6T national debt
